Ordo for the 2019 Liturgical Year

This is an ordo (liturgical calendar) for the 2019 liturgical year for the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass in the Extraordinary Form according to the Missale Romanum (1962) of Pope St. John XXIII.  This ordo is intended as a general guide.  It does not show feasts which are observed only in particular places or by particular congregations.  It does not show votive Masses on the days when they are permitted by the rubrics.  If a Mass is shown in this color, it means that Propers for that Mass are available on this site.

Every liturgical year begins on the First Sunday of Advent in November or December in the preceding calendar year. The First Sunday of Advent is always the fourth Sunday preceding December 25. It can fall as early as November 27, and as late as December 3. The current year began on Sunday, December 2, 2018.
